events.detail: rsETH OFT adapter deployed on Ethereum (no code at the previous block)
Unichain route (eid 30320) set to 1 required DVN (LZ Labs), 0 optional, by an EOA delegate, not the Safe
Delegate moves from the EOA to the 3-of-6 Safe; verifier set untouched
Floor scan: BREACHED. 24 of 26 inbound routes resolve to one verifier; 25 of 26 receive libraries unpinned
Adapter releases 116,500 rsETH on a forged message from the Unichain route
First Aave borrow against the released rsETH, 22 blocks after the drain
Aave freezes rsETH on Ethereum Core, about 88 minutes after the drain
About 25 send-side routes moved to 4 required DVNs; Unichain receive library pinned
